# light-view

> light-view is a free, open-source image viewer for Windows 10 22H2 and Windows 11 (x64). It opens iPhone photos (HEIC/HEIF) without Microsoft's paid HEVC extension, and JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP and BMP. Made by goodflow; MIT or Apache-2.0.

The site is in Korean (default) and English (/en/). Downloads come only from the project's GitHub Releases; the official places are lightview.goodflow.dev and github.com/hyunwook-kim-goodflow/light-view.

## What it does

- Opens HEIC/HEIF photos for free, decoding them in a separate, sandboxed worker process.
- Flip through a folder with ← and →; zoom with the wheel or a double-click.
- Lossless JPEG rotation (Ctrl+← / Ctrl+→, save with Ctrl+S).
- Delete to the Recycle Bin with undo (Ctrl+Z).
- EXIF card (I key): date taken, camera, exposure; copy any tag.
- Resize a batch of photos for upload to a resolution, file size or scale, as JPEG, PNG or WebP; location data removed by default. Converting HEIC to JPEG works this way.
- The installed version shows HEIC thumbnails in Windows Explorer.
- No ads, no tracking, no account; the only network use is an optional update check. Releases are not code-signed yet; each comes with SHA-256 checksums.
